newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish central bank injects 38.75 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turkish central bank injects 38.75 trln lira.

text.p: 1420 GMT - Turkish central bank funded 30 trillion lira at 75 percent overnight after injecting 8.75 trillion lira via a seven-day repo auction. * Turkish lira weakened to 90,170 per dollar from Wednesday's 90,110 close on banks' dollar demand despite cash squeeze. * Currency mkt was uneffected by Prime Minister Erbakan's second ressource package. * T-bill yields ended lower after brief volatility caused by package. Yields had firmed at opening on tight liquidity.
